cooking_effort: medium - some from-scratch is fine, mix of quick weeknight and weekend projects
budget: moderate - standard grocery prices, name brands or store brands both fine

avoid: mushrooms in any whole/sliced form (canned cream of mushroom soup is acceptable ONLY in cooked casserole-type dishes)
stone fruits: peaches, nectarines, plums, apricots, cherries (treat mango as stone fruit - drupe)
tree nuts: almonds, cashews, walnuts, pecans, pistachios, hazelnuts, macadamia (watch 'may contain tree nuts' in packaged sauces/granolas)
diet_rules.notes: Peanuts not excluded by user but flag peanut items if substituting for tree-nut recipes. Oats/granola bars: verify no tree-nut ingredients.

plan_shape.structure: each day = 1 main + 1-2 sides; rotate proteins (beef, poultry, pork, fish, 1-2 vegetarian); variety of cuisines; repeat no main protein+style within the week
plan_shape.sides_rule: sides should work across mains (e.g. one bag of salad greens spanning 2 days) to keep the shopping list sane
